title: RoboDoctor: Training-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Robot Policies
why: Training-free RSI with fixed policy/LM weights: harness RSI allocates hybrid vs direct control; intervention RSI decides keep-or-correct; operation RSI revises physical methods from observed effects; linked experience records retain decisions for reuse across episodes.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: curated archive of 54 RoboDojo-Sim task entries; five-dimension mean 57.10 with native success 49.44%; Warmup→Refinement gain described on project page (~7.37). Authors note controlled trials still needed to isolate cross-episode experience.
